items.title: After 20 years, jet diffusion wakes detected in quark-gluon plasmas
items.abstract: Boats passing over smooth water form a pair of diffusion wakes behind them veering off at a certain angle. Turbulence occurs along the line directly behind the boat, but the two diffusion waves are at a theoretical angle of 19.5° from the same line, for deep, ideally smooth water.
